name: northwind-support-golden
description: Golden set for the Northwind Cloud support assistant. Each answerable case carries a ground-truth answer, the facts the retriever must surface (expected_context) and deterministic assertions. Out-of-scope cases (answerable=false) check that the assistant declines instead of hallucinating.

cases.question: How much does the Team plan cost?
cases.ground_truth: The Team plan costs 29 euros per user per month.
expected_context: The Team plan costs 29 euros per user per month

cases.question: How much storage does the Starter plan include?
cases.ground_truth: The Starter plan includes 50 GB of storage.
expected_context: The Starter plan includes 50 GB of storage

cases.question: What discount do annual payments get?
cases.ground_truth: Customers who pay annually receive a 15 percent discount on every plan.
expected_context: Customers who pay annually receive a 15 percent discount

cases.question: When are invoices issued?
cases.ground_truth: Invoices are issued on the first day of each month and are payable within 30 days.
expected_context: Invoices are issued on the first day of each month

cases.question: Which regions host customer data?
cases.ground_truth: Customer data is hosted in Frankfurt and Paris and never leaves the European Union.
expected_context: Customer data is hosted in the Frankfurt and Paris regions

cases.question: How fast are security incidents reported?
cases.ground_truth: Security incidents are reported to affected customers within 72 hours.
expected_context: Security incidents are reported to affected customers within 72 hours

cases.question: What encryption is used for data at rest?
cases.ground_truth: Customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256.
expected_context: All customer data is encrypted at rest with AES-256

cases.question: Which certifications and audits does Northwind Cloud have?
cases.ground_truth: Northwind Cloud is ISO 27001 certified and completes a SOC 2 Type II audit every year.
expected_context: Northwind Cloud is certified ISO 27001 and completes a SOC 2 Type II audit every year

cases.question: What is the API rate limit?
cases.ground_truth: The API rate limit is 600 requests per minute per organization.
expected_context: The API rate limit is 600 requests per minute per organization

cases.question: What HTTP status code is returned when the rate limit is exceeded?
cases.ground_truth: The API returns HTTP status 429 with a Retry-After header.
expected_context: When the rate limit is exceeded the API returns HTTP status 429

cases.question: How are webhooks signed?
cases.ground_truth: Webhooks are signed with HMAC SHA-256 using the secret from the admin console.
expected_context: Webhooks are signed with HMAC SHA-256

cases.question: What is the current API version?
cases.ground_truth: The current version of the REST API is v3.
expected_context: The REST API is versioned and the current version is v3

cases.question: How long are backups kept?
cases.ground_truth: Backups are kept for 35 days.
expected_context: Backups are taken every 6 hours and kept for 35 days

cases.question: When is customer data deleted after an account is closed?
cases.ground_truth: Customer data is permanently deleted 90 days after the account is closed.
expected_context: When an account is closed, customer data is permanently deleted after 90 days

cases.question: Can I export my data?
cases.ground_truth: Yes, customers can export all their data at any time in JSON or CSV format from the admin console.
expected_context: Customers can export all their data at any time in JSON or CSV format

cases.question: What is the response time for critical incidents on Enterprise?
cases.ground_truth: Enterprise customers get 24/7 phone support with a one hour response time for critical incidents.
expected_context: Enterprise customers get 24/7 phone support with a one hour response time for critical incidents

cases.question: How much do the Starter and Team plans cost per user?
cases.ground_truth: The Starter plan costs 12 euros and the Team plan costs 29 euros per user per month.
expected_context: The Starter plan costs 12 euros per user per month
The Team plan costs 29 euros per user per month

cases.question: How often are backups taken, and how long do deleted files stay in the trash?
cases.ground_truth: Backups are taken every 6 hours, and deleted files stay in the trash for 30 days.
expected_context: Backups are taken every 6 hours
Deleted files stay in the trash for 30 days

cases.question: What support do Team customers get compared with Enterprise customers?
cases.ground_truth: Team customers get live chat support on business days, while Enterprise customers get 24/7 phone support.
expected_context: Team customers get live chat support from 8am to 8pm
Enterprise customers get 24/7 phone support

cases.question: Which TLS version protects data in transit, and where is the data hosted?
cases.ground_truth: Data in transit is protected with TLS 1.3 and hosted in the Frankfurt and Paris regions.
expected_context: encrypted in transit with TLS 1.3
Customer data is hosted in the Frankfurt and Paris regions
